# Southbelt Repair and Supply Inc.

> Southbelt Repair & Supply Co. Inc. builds concrete batch plants, pugmills and silos, supplies batch plant parts, repairs and maintains plant equipment, fabricates, and rents and sells equipment for the concrete and industrial industries. Servicing concrete batch plants since 2002. Headquarters: 109 North Richey St, Pasadena, TX 77506, 713-645-9099. Email: sales@southbeltinc.com.

## Locations

- Houston (Headquarters): 109 North Richey St, Pasadena, TX 77506, 713-645-9099
- San Marcos (Branch): 1110 FM 1339, Kingsbury, TX 78638, 830-372-8929
- Dallas (Branch): 4525 Maxey Rd, Alvarado, TX 76009, 682-518-6622

## Equipment

- [BP-14 Concrete Batch Plant](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/bp-14-batch-plant): A 14-yard cement batcher under a 400 to 1900 BBL batching silo, with overhead bins, an aggregate batcher and a radial stacker.
- [BP-14 Augerless Batch Plant](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/bp-14-augerless-batch-plant): The BP-14 specification without the 10-inch WAM auger on the auxiliary silo, with the same 14-yard batcher and 400 to 1900 BBL silo.
- [DP-12 Decumulating Plant](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/dp-12-decumulating-plant): A low-profile decum plant loaded directly by a front-end loader, with a 400 to 1200 BBL silo and gravity discharge.
- [SBM-12 Semi-Mobile Batch Plant](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/sbm-12-semi-mobile-batch-plant): A semi-mobile plant whose mainframe carries the knee braces for an auxiliary silo, so a second cement silo can go on years later.
- [Portable Pugmill](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/portable-pugmill): A pugmill that moves between jobs, at 500, 750 or 1000 TPH, with silos from 400 to 1200 BBL and a conveyor belt scale.
- [Stationary Pugmill](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/stationary-pugmill): A fixed pugmill at 500, 750 or 1000 TPH, with silos from 400 to 1200 BBL and options for a surge hopper and shaker screen.
- [Vertical Pigs](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/vertical-pigs): Vertical silos that fill and discharge at the same time, on a smaller footprint than a horizontal pig.
- [Portable Storage Pigs](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/portable-storage-pigs): Made in the USA, with tilted bottom pods, a retractable ladder and your choice of diesel or electric blower. New, used or for rent.
- [Dry Bulk Blowers](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/dry-bulk-blowers): Paragon 1057, P858 and P657 blowers, comparable to Gardner Denver and Tuthill, plus the service kits that keep them running.
- [Self-Erecting Water Tank](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/self-erecting-water-tank): A Mega portable tank with 12,000 gallons of nominal capacity, a hydraulic hoist and a 10-inch discharge pipe.
- [RM-Series Industrial Conveyor](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/equipment/rm-series-conveyor): A towable 23 or 28 ft conveyor with an 18-inch belt that doses fiber, ice, bags, aggregate, rock and sand.

## Parts

- [Electric Motors](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/electric-motors): Electric motors from WEG, Baldor and North American.
- [Gear Reducers](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/gear-reducers): Gear reducers and gearboxes from Dodge, Rexnord and SEW.
- [Bearings](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/bearings): Bearings from Dodge, Link-Belt and Rexnord, and Craft split bearings.
- [Dust Collectors](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/dust-collectors): Silo and central dust collectors from C&W Manufacturing and WAM, and their filters.
- [Anti-Overfill Systems](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/anti-overfill-systems): C&W Manufacturing anti-overfill systems and pinch valve kits for silos.
- [Screw Conveyors](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/screw-conveyors): WAM screw conveyors, augers and flights.
- [Rotary Vane Feeders](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/rotary-vane-feeders): Rotary vane feeders and airlocks from Smoot and WAM.
- [Chains and Sprockets](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/chains-and-sprockets): Chains and sprockets for plant drives.
- [Air Valves and Air Cylinders](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/air-valves-and-cylinders): Air valves, solenoids and air cylinders from Schrader Bellows, MAC and SMC.
- [Air Compressors and Parts](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/air-compressors): Quincy and Schulz air compressors, and components for the compressor you run.
- [Cement and Air Hose and Fittings](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/cement-and-air-hose): Sealfast cement hose, air hose and fittings.
- [Water Pumps and Parts](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/water-pumps): Water pumps, and components for the pumps already on your plant.
- [Butterfly Valves](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/butterfly-valves): Butterfly valves from Bray, WAM and Keystone.
- [Conveyor Belting and Fasteners](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/conveyor-belting): Conveyor belting from a large inventory, with fasteners, vulcanization and installation.
- [Belt Cleaners, Covers and Idlers](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/belt-cleaners-and-idlers): Belt cleaners, conveyor covers and idlers from PPI and Martin Engineering.
- [Conveyor Pulleys](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/conveyor-pulleys): Head, tail and drive pulleys from Dodge, PPI and Superior.
- [V-Belts](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/v-belts): Bestorq V-belts for conveyor and blower drives.
- [Emergency Stop and Limit Switches](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/emergency-stop-switches): Conveyor Components Co. emergency stop switches, and limit switches.
- [Batch Plant Automation](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/batch-plant-automation): Command Alkon and Jonel batch plant automation.
- [Level Indicators](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/level-indicators): Bin and silo level indicators from BinMaster, Blue Lake and Bindicator.
- [Load Cells](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/load-cells): Rice Lake load cells for cement, aggregate and water batchers.
- [Water Meters](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/water-meters): Badger Meter water meters for batch plants.
- [Pneumatic Blowers](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/pneumatic-blowers): Tuthill and Paragon pneumatic blowers, new and used.
- [Paragon Blower Service Kits](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/paragon-blower-service-kits): Synthetic oil, melt plugs and filter elements for the Paragon P657, P858 and P1057.
- [Vibrators](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/vibrators): Vibrators from Houston Vibrator Inc. and Vibco.
- [Concrete Mixers](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/concrete-mixers): Erie Strayer Co. concrete mixers.
- [Slumpstands](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/slumpstands): C&W Manufacturing slumpstands.
- [Shaker Screens](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/shaker-screens): Shaker screens, including the option on the stationary pugmill.
- [Water Chillers](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/water-chillers): American Geo-Thermal water chillers for batch plants.
- [Urethane Liners](https://southbelt.taylorurl.com/parts/urethane-liners): Rhino Hyde urethane liners for hoppers, bins and chutes.
